name: android-host
description: On-device Android agent host: ships Node and the Midscene agent inside an APK and drives the device through a shell channel (Shizuku, or the device's own adbd).

scripts.assemble: pnpm exec nx build @midscene/android-local && pnpm run runtime && pnpm run adb-runtime && pnpm run bundle && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.assemble:release: pnpm exec nx build @midscene/android-local && pnpm run runtime && pnpm run adb-runtime && pnpm run bundle && ./gradlew assembleRelease
